title: Bankable
tagline: A DeFi AI agent that makes onboarding easy for first time users
description: This AI agent enables you to engage in a chat conversation about your DeFi investment goals. As suggestions are provided to help you achieve these goals, you gain direct access to DeFi projects that align with your requirements—all without leaving the platform. This is done to make onboarding easier for anyone trying to get started with DeFi.
how_its_made: We built this using google gemini, thridweb,, solidty, nextjs, chakra-ui, https://horizon-ui.com/, https://github.com/horizon-ui/horizon-ui-chakra. We first built a chat bot and UI using gemini apis then we built our dApp using thirdweb and solidity ERC20 contracts. We built out an interface that suggest DeFi tools to meet your goals and then gives you access to the DeFi tool without leaving the site.
